checks: organization membership and editor role are required before order access
cross-origin requests, unsupported methods, malformed and oversized bodies are rejected
draft sends and unconfigured mail never change Contacted or call the provider
confirmed sends derive the recipient and reply thread from CRM and persist exact text
accepted retries and repeated provider events never send or log twice
reusing an idempotency key for changed content is rejected
provider rejection or network uncertainty cannot mark a customer Contacted
a database failure after provider acceptance retries the log without resending
shared-workspace conflicts re-read and preserve unrelated concurrent edits
receiving webhooks fetch original text and make exactly one linked follow-up
reply matching uses the recipient token and CRM contact, never order text
customer instructions cannot cancel, allocate stock or escape their order
oversized or HTML-only receiving bodies require review without a partial log
invalid signatures stop before inbox or workspace access
server monitoring requires the cron secret and stores revision-bound alerts
Svix verification covers the exact raw body, timestamp and signing key
method: Synthetic authenticated requests, provider responses and durable job store. No live email or credentials.
